blocks.x: Ports and carriers orchestrate billion-dollar physics: berth planning, crane productivity, vessel scheduling and cargo integrity. Telemetry-to-decision loops (berth windows, yard flows, maintenance) decide throughput on the same infrastructure — pure intelligence arbitrage.

The workflows we industrialize here: Berth/vessel planning, Yard/gate orchestration, Crane/equipment maintenance, Cargo integrity, Documentation (eBL). Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Vessel schedules vs. yard reality disconnected; anchorage waits cost.
Maersk-class ransomware memory; OT/corporate segmentation thin.
Truck appointments and yard moves on radio; congestion.
Paper bills of lading persist; fraud and delay.

blocks.x: How we help — five priority capabilities

items: vessel/yard/tide data unified for planning — waits down
telemetry into predictive maintenance — availability up
IT/OT segmentation and recovery drills — restart proven
stowage/berth formulations across solvers — planning gains evidenced
electronic bills with legal-grade evidence — fraud/delay down

blocks.x: A typical program here starts with a two-week diagnostic that measures the workflows named above and locks the baseline, moves through a gated proof on your data, then industrializes on platform rails with the sector's compliance evidence generated in-flight.

items: Exceptions auto-resolved at 74% — control tower to agentic remediation
